# ===== Parameters =====
STORAGE = "abfss://adani-ct03@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net"
EC_PATH = f"{STORAGE}/silver/ecevents"
MH_PATH = f"{STORAGE}/silver/moves"
SOURCE_FORMAT = "delta"            # change to "parquet" if silver is plain parquet
OUTPUT_BASE = f"{STORAGE}/gold/tto_dispatch_violations"   # confirm gold location

RUN_ALL = True                     # True = whole EC history; False = use the dates below
START_DATE = "2026-10-15"          # used only when RUN_ALL = False (shift date, inclusive)
END_DATE   = "2026-10-16"          # used only when RUN_ALL = False (shift date, exclusive)

LOOKBACK_DAYS = 1                  # extra EC history so jobs started before START_DATE are complete
MH_MARGIN_DAYS = 2                 # move history is read wider than the EC window
MATCH_TOLERANCE_HOURS = 24         # max gap between EC job time and the matched move

SHIFT_STARTS = ["07:00", "19:00"]
SHIFT_NAMES  = ["Day", "Night"]    # PLACEHOLDER - replace with CT03's real shift pattern
WRITE_OUTPUT = True               # set True once results look right

from datetime import timedelta
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

if RUN_ALL:
    _ec = spark.read.format(SOURCE_FORMAT).load(EC_PATH).filter(F.col("che_kind") == "ITV")
    _ts = F.col("event_ts")
    if dict(_ec.dtypes)["event_ts"] == "string":
        _ts = F.to_timestamp(F.substring(F.regexp_replace("event_ts", "T", " "), 1, 23))
    b = _ec.select(F.min(_ts).alias("mn"), F.max(_ts).alias("mx")).first()

    first_shift_start = int(SHIFT_STARTS[0].split(":")[0])
    start = b.mn.date() - timedelta(days=1) if b.mn.hour < first_shift_start else b.mn.date()
    START_DATE = str(start)
    END_DATE = str(b.mx.date() + timedelta(days=1))
    print(f"Full run: EC {b.mn} to {b.mx}  ->  shift dates {START_DATE} to {END_DATE} (exclusive)")

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window as W

def read_silver(path):
    return spark.read.format(SOURCE_FORMAT).load(path)

def latest_version(df, key):
    """Keep one row per key (latest silver load), in case silver holds reloads."""
    if "_silver_loaded_at" not in df.columns:
        return df.dropDuplicates([key])
    w = W.partitionBy(key).orderBy(F.col("_silver_loaded_at").desc())
    return df.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w)).filter("_rn = 1").drop("_rn")

def as_ts(df, col):
    """Parse ISO strings like 2026-10-15T00:08:31.0000000; leave real timestamps alone."""
    if dict(df.dtypes)[col] == "string":
        return df.withColumn(col, F.to_timestamp(F.substring(F.regexp_replace(col, "T", " "), 1, 23)))
    return df

ec_start = F.expr(f"timestamp'{START_DATE} 00:00:00' - interval {LOOKBACK_DAYS} days")
ec_end   = ec_end = F.expr(f"timestamp'{END_DATE} {SHIFT_STARTS[0]}:00'")

# ---- EC events: ITV only ----
ec = latest_version(read_silver(EC_PATH), "ec_event_gkey")
ec = ec.filter(F.col("che_kind") == "ITV")
if "event_date" in ec.columns:   # partition pruning if silver is partitioned by event_date
    ec = ec.filter((F.col("event_date") >= F.date_sub(F.lit(START_DATE).cast("date"), LOOKBACK_DAYS)) &
                   (F.col("event_date") <  F.lit(END_DATE).cast("date")))
ec = as_ts(ec, "event_ts")
ec = (ec
      .filter((F.col("event_ts") >= ec_start) & (F.col("event_ts") < ec_end))
      .withColumn("ec_event_gkey", F.col("ec_event_gkey").cast("long"))
      .withColumn("wa", F.col("work_assignment_gkey").cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("string"))
      .withColumn("units", F.filter(F.transform(F.split(F.coalesce(F.col("unit_nbrs"), F.lit("")), ";"),
                                                lambda x: F.trim(x)), lambda x: x != ""))
      .select("ec_event_gkey", "event_ts", "che_name", "event_type_desc", "units", "pow", "wa")
      .cache())

# ---- Move history: LOAD / DSCH only ----
mh_start = F.expr(f"timestamp'{START_DATE} 00:00:00' - interval {LOOKBACK_DAYS + MH_MARGIN_DAYS} days")
mh_end   = F.expr(f"timestamp'{END_DATE} 00:00:00' + interval {MH_MARGIN_DAYS} days")

mh = latest_version(read_silver(MH_PATH), "mve_gkey").filter(F.col("move_kind").isin("LOAD", "DSCH"))
for c in ["t_put", "t_carry_complete", "t_fetch"]:
    mh = as_ts(mh, c)

mh = (mh
      .withColumn("move_ts", F.coalesce("t_put", "t_carry_complete", "t_fetch"))
      .filter((F.col("move_ts") >= mh_start) & (F.col("move_ts") < mh_end))
      # actual quay crane: fetch CHE for discharge, put CHE for load
      .withColumn("qc_id", F.when(F.col("move_kind") == "DSCH",
                                  F.when(F.col("fetch_che_kind") == "QC", F.col("fetch_che_id")))
                            .otherwise(F.when(F.col("put_che_kind") == "QC", F.col("put_che_id"))))
      .withColumn("qc_name", F.when(F.col("qc_id").isNotNull(),
                                    F.concat(F.lit("STS"), F.lpad(F.col("qc_id").cast("int").cast("string"), 2, "0"))))
      .withColumn("vessel_slot", F.when(F.col("move_kind") == "DSCH", F.col("from_position_name"))
                                  .otherwise(F.col("to_position_name")))
      .withColumn("vessel_bay", F.regexp_extract("vessel_slot", r"^V-[^-]+-(\d{2})\d{4}$", 1))
      .withColumn("yard_block", F.when(F.col("move_kind") == "LOAD", F.col("fm_yard_block"))
                                 .otherwise(F.col("to_yard_block")))
      # size: ISO type first char (2=20ft, 4/L=40/45ft), fallback odd/even vessel bay
      .withColumn("size_ft",
                  F.when(F.substring("equipment_type", 1, 1) == "2", 20)
                   .when(F.substring("equipment_type", 1, 1).isin("4", "L"), 40)
                   .when((F.col("vessel_bay") != "") & (F.col("vessel_bay").cast("int") % 2 == 1), 20)
                   .when((F.col("vessel_bay") != "") & (F.col("vessel_bay").cast("int") % 2 == 0), 40))
      .select("mve_gkey", "unit_nbr", "move_kind", "move_ts", "qc_name", "vessel_slot", "yard_block", "size_ft",
            F.col("dist_laden").cast("double").alias("dist_laden"),
            F.col("dist_unladen").cast("double").alias("dist_unladen"))
      .cache())

print("EC ITV events:", ec.count(), "| LOAD/DSCH moves:", mh.count())

DISPATCH  = ["TYCO", "TVCO"]
PICKUP    = ["TVDR", "TYDR"]
BREAK_OUT = ["UNAV", "LGOF"]

wa_diag = (ec.filter(F.col("wa").isNotNull())
           .groupBy("wa")
           .agg(F.countDistinct("che_name").alias("trucks"),
                F.sum(F.col("event_type_desc").isin(DISPATCH).cast("int")).alias("dispatches"),
                F.sum(F.col("event_type_desc").isin(PICKUP).cast("int")).alias("pickups")))

display(wa_diag.groupBy("trucks", "dispatches", "pickups").count().orderBy(F.desc("count")))
print("Events without a work assignment:",
      ec.filter(F.col("wa").isNull()).groupBy("event_type_desc").count().orderBy(F.desc("count")).collect())

job_key = ["che_name", "wa"]
w_job = W.partitionBy(*job_key)
etype = F.col("event_type_desc")

ev = (ec.filter(F.col("wa").isNotNull())
        .withColumn("dispatch_gkey", F.min(F.when(etype.isin(DISPATCH), F.col("ec_event_gkey"))).over(w_job))
        .withColumn("pickup_gkey",   F.min(F.when(etype.isin(PICKUP),   F.col("ec_event_gkey"))).over(w_job)))

before_pickup = F.col("pickup_gkey").isNull() | (F.col("ec_event_gkey") < F.col("pickup_gkey"))
from_pickup   = F.col("ec_event_gkey") >= F.col("pickup_gkey")

jobs = (ev.groupBy(*job_key).agg(
    F.first("dispatch_gkey").alias("dispatch_gkey"),
    F.first("pickup_gkey").alias("pickup_gkey"),
    F.min(F.when((etype == "CMPL") & (F.col("ec_event_gkey") > F.col("pickup_gkey")),
                 F.col("ec_event_gkey"))).alias("cmpl_gkey"),
    F.array_distinct(F.flatten(F.collect_list(
        F.when(etype.isin(DISPATCH) & before_pickup, F.col("units"))))).alias("dispatched_units"),
    # carried = pickup units + CMPL units (twin discharge shows both units only at CMPL)
    F.array_distinct(F.flatten(F.collect_list(
        F.when(from_pickup & etype.isin(PICKUP + ["CMPL"]), F.col("units"))))).alias("carried_units"),
    F.max((etype == "ABJB").cast("int")).alias("has_abjb"),
    F.max((etype == "AYCO").cast("int")).alias("has_ayco"),
    F.max((etype == "AVCO").cast("int")).alias("has_avco"),
    F.max((etype == "AYDR").cast("int")).alias("has_aydr"),
    F.max((etype == "AVDR").cast("int")).alias("has_avdr"),
))

# attach timestamp / type / POW of the dispatch, pickup and CMPL events
attr = ec.select("ec_event_gkey", "event_ts", "event_type_desc", "pow")
for prefix in ["dispatch", "pickup", "cmpl"]:
    a = attr.select(F.col("ec_event_gkey").alias(f"{prefix}_gkey"),
                    F.col("event_ts").alias(f"{prefix}_ts"),
                    F.col("event_type_desc").alias(f"{prefix}_type"),
                    F.col("pow").alias(f"{prefix}_pow"))
    jobs = jobs.join(a, f"{prefix}_gkey", "left")

jobs = (jobs
        .withColumn("dispatched_move", F.when(F.col("dispatch_type") == "TYCO", "LOAD")
                                        .when(F.col("dispatch_type") == "TVCO", "DSCH"))
        .withColumn("carried_move", F.when(F.col("pickup_type") == "TVDR", "LOAD")
                                     .when(F.col("pickup_type") == "TYDR", "DSCH")))

# ---- breaks (UNAV/LGOF) between the reference dispatch and the pickup ----
dispatch_ev = ec.filter(F.col("event_type_desc").isin(DISPATCH)).select(
    F.col("che_name").alias("d_truck"), F.col("ec_event_gkey").alias("d_gkey"), F.col("wa").alias("d_wa"))
break_ev = ec.filter(F.col("event_type_desc").isin(BREAK_OUT)).select(
    F.col("che_name").alias("b_truck"), F.col("ec_event_gkey").alias("b_gkey"))

picked = jobs.filter(F.col("pickup_gkey").isNotNull()).select(*job_key, "dispatch_gkey", "pickup_gkey")

# previous dispatch of the same truck (any work assignment) before this pickup
prev = (picked.join(dispatch_ev, (F.col("che_name") == F.col("d_truck")) & (F.col("d_gkey") < F.col("pickup_gkey")))
              .groupBy(*job_key)
              .agg(F.max(F.struct("d_gkey", "d_wa")).alias("p")))
prev = prev.select(*job_key, F.col("p.d_gkey").alias("prev_dispatch_gkey"), F.col("p.d_wa").alias("prev_wa"))

picked = (picked.join(prev, job_key, "left")
                .withColumn("ref_dispatch_gkey", F.coalesce("dispatch_gkey", "prev_dispatch_gkey")))

brk = (picked.join(break_ev, (F.col("che_name") == F.col("b_truck")) &
                             (F.col("b_gkey") > F.col("ref_dispatch_gkey")) &
                             (F.col("b_gkey") < F.col("pickup_gkey")))
             .groupBy(*job_key).agg(F.lit(1).alias("break_before_pickup")))

# was the previous job (if a different WA) left without a pickup?
# was the previous job (if a different WA) left without a pickup?
prev_job_state = jobs.select(F.col("che_name").alias("pj_truck"), F.col("wa").alias("pj_wa"),
                             F.col("pickup_gkey").isNull().cast("int").alias("prev_job_not_collected"))

picked = (picked.join(brk, job_key, "left")
                .join(prev_job_state,
                      (F.col("che_name") == F.col("pj_truck")) & (F.col("prev_wa") == F.col("pj_wa")),
                      "left")
                .select(*job_key, "prev_dispatch_gkey", "prev_wa",
                        F.coalesce("break_before_pickup", F.lit(0)).alias("break_before_pickup"),
                        F.coalesce("prev_job_not_collected", F.lit(0)).alias("prev_job_not_collected")))

jobs = jobs.join(picked, job_key, "left").cache()
print("Jobs:", jobs.count())

unit_side = (jobs.filter(F.col("pickup_gkey").isNotNull())
             .select(*job_key, F.lit("d").alias("side"),
                     F.explode("dispatched_units").alias("unit_nbr"), F.col("dispatch_ts").alias("ref_ts"))
             .unionByName(
                 jobs.filter(F.col("pickup_gkey").isNotNull())
                     .select(*job_key, F.lit("c").alias("side"),
                             F.explode("carried_units").alias("unit_nbr"), F.col("pickup_ts").alias("ref_ts"))))

cand = (unit_side.join(mh, "unit_nbr")
        .withColumn("diff_s", F.abs(F.col("move_ts").cast("long") - F.col("ref_ts").cast("long")))
        .filter(F.col("diff_s") <= MATCH_TOLERANCE_HOURS * 3600))
best = (cand.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(
                W.partitionBy(*job_key, "side", "unit_nbr").orderBy("diff_s")))
            .filter("rn = 1").drop("rn", "ref_ts"))

matched = unit_side.join(best, job_key + ["side", "unit_nbr"], "left")

side_agg = (matched.groupBy(*job_key, "side").agg(
    F.count("*").alias("n_units"),
    F.count("mve_gkey").alias("n_matched"),
    F.first("qc_name", ignorenulls=True).alias("qc"),
    F.collect_set("yard_block").alias("blocks"),
    F.max("size_ft").alias("max_size"),
    F.collect_set("move_kind").alias("mh_moves"),
    F.max("dist_laden").alias("dist_laden"),
    F.max("dist_unladen").alias("dist_unladen"))
  .withColumn("size_cat", F.when((F.col("n_units") >= 2) & (F.col("max_size") == 20), "2x20")
                           .when(F.col("max_size") == 40, "40")
                           .when(F.col("max_size") == 20, "20")))

def side(s, p):
    return side_agg.filter(F.col("side") == s).select(
        *job_key, *[F.col(c).alias(f"{p}_{c}") for c in ["n_units", "n_matched", "qc", "blocks", "size_cat", "mh_moves", "dist_laden", "dist_unladen"]])

enriched = (jobs.join(side("d", "d"), job_key, "left")
                .join(side("c", "c"), job_key, "left")
                # MH crane first, EC POW as fallback
                .withColumn("dispatched_qc", F.coalesce("d_qc", "dispatch_pow"))
                .withColumn("carried_qc",    F.coalesce("c_qc", "pickup_pow"))
                .withColumn("qc_ec_mh_mismatch",
                            (F.col("c_qc").isNotNull() & F.col("pickup_pow").isNotNull() &
                             (F.col("c_qc") != F.col("pickup_pow"))).cast("int")))

def flag(cond):
    return F.coalesce(cond, F.lit(False)).cast("int")

disp_dsch = F.col("dispatched_move") == "DSCH"
disp_load = F.col("dispatched_move") == "LOAD"
done_dsch = F.col("carried_move") == "DSCH"
done_load = F.col("carried_move") == "LOAD"
qc_diff   = F.col("dispatched_qc") != F.col("carried_qc")
small_to_40 = F.col("d_size_cat").isin("20", "2x20") & (F.col("c_size_cat") == "40")
no_unit_overlap = F.size(F.array_intersect("dispatched_units", "carried_units")) == 0
block_diff = (F.size("d_blocks") > 0) & (F.size("c_blocks") > 0) & \
             (F.size(F.array_intersect("d_blocks", "c_blocks")) == 0)

res = (enriched.filter(F.col("pickup_gkey").isNotNull())
       .withColumn("D1", flag(disp_dsch & done_dsch & qc_diff & ~small_to_40))
       .withColumn("D3", flag(disp_dsch & done_dsch & qc_diff & small_to_40))
       .withColumn("D2", flag(disp_dsch & done_load))
       .withColumn("L3", flag(disp_load & done_dsch))
       .withColumn("L1", flag(disp_load & done_load & no_unit_overlap & block_diff))
       .withColumn("L2", flag(disp_load & (F.col("d_size_cat") == "2x20") & (F.col("c_size_cat") == "40")))
       .withColumn("N1", flag((F.col("break_before_pickup") == 1) &
                              ((F.col("dispatch_gkey").isNull() & (F.col("prev_job_not_collected") == 1)) |
                               (F.col("dispatch_gkey").isNotNull() & no_unit_overlap)))))

main = F.lit(None).cast("string")
for case in reversed(["D1", "D3", "D2", "L3", "L1", "L2", "N1"]):   # priority order from the doc
    main = F.when(F.col(case) == 1, F.lit(case)).otherwise(main)

def add_shift(df, ts_col):
    starts = sorted(int(h) * 60 + int(m) for h, m in (s.split(":") for s in SHIFT_STARTS))
    mins = F.hour(ts_col) * 60 + F.minute(ts_col)
    shift = F.lit(len(starts))                       # before first start = last shift of previous day
    for i, s in enumerate(starts, 1):
        shift = F.when(mins >= s, F.lit(i)).otherwise(shift)
    return (df.withColumn("shift_no", shift)
            .withColumn("shift_name", F.element_at(F.array(*[F.lit(n) for n in SHIFT_NAMES]), shift))
            .withColumn("shift_date", F.when(mins < starts[0], F.date_sub(F.to_date(ts_col), 1))
                                        .otherwise(F.to_date(ts_col))))


res = (res.withColumn("main_case", main)
          .withColumn("job_ts", F.coalesce("dispatch_ts", "pickup_ts"))
          .withColumn("job_date", F.to_date("job_ts"))
          .withColumn("dq_more_than_2_units", flag((F.col("d_n_units") > 2) | (F.col("c_n_units") > 2)))
          .withColumn("dq_unmatched_units", flag((F.col("d_n_matched") < F.col("d_n_units")) |
                                                 (F.col("c_n_matched") < F.col("c_n_units"))))
          .withColumn("no_dispatch", flag(F.col("dispatch_gkey").isNull())))
res = (add_shift(res, "job_ts")
          .filter((F.col("shift_date") >= F.lit(START_DATE).cast("date")) &
                  (F.col("shift_date") <  F.lit(END_DATE).cast("date")))
          .cache())


violations = (res.filter(F.col("main_case").isNotNull())
              .select("job_date", "shift_date", "shift_no", "shift_name","job_ts",
                      F.col("che_name").alias("truck"), "wa",
                      F.concat_ws(";", "dispatched_units").alias("unit_dispatched"), "dispatched_move",
                      "dispatched_qc", F.concat_ws(";", "d_blocks").alias("dispatched_block"), "d_size_cat",
                      F.concat_ws(";", "carried_units").alias("unit_received"), "carried_move",
                      "carried_qc", F.concat_ws(";", "c_blocks").alias("carried_block"), "c_size_cat",
                      "main_case", "D1", "D3", "D2", "L3", "L1", "L2", "N1",
                      "dq_more_than_2_units", "dq_unmatched_units", "qc_ec_mh_mismatch"))

display(violations.groupBy("main_case").count().orderBy("main_case"))
display(violations.orderBy("job_ts"))

base = res.filter(F.col("dq_more_than_2_units") == 0)

summary = (base.groupBy("shift_date", "shift_no","shift_name", "che_name").agg(
    F.count("*").alias("jobs_picked_up"),
    F.sum(F.col("dispatched_move").eqNullSafe("DSCH").cast("int")).alias("dsch_dispatches"),
    F.sum(F.col("dispatched_move").eqNullSafe("LOAD").cast("int")).alias("load_dispatches"),
    *[F.sum(F.col("main_case").eqNullSafe(c).cast("int")).alias(c) for c in ["D1", "D3", "D2", "L3", "L1", "L2", "N1"]])
  .withColumn("D_rate", (F.col("D1") + F.col("D2") + F.col("D3")) / F.col("dsch_dispatches"))
  .withColumn("L_rate", (F.col("L1") + F.col("L2") + F.col("L3")) / F.col("load_dispatches"))
  .withColumn("N1_rate", F.col("N1") / F.col("jobs_picked_up")))

window_jobs = add_shift(jobs.withColumn("job_ts", F.coalesce("dispatch_ts", "pickup_ts")), "job_ts").filter(
    (F.col("shift_date") >= F.lit(START_DATE).cast("date")) & (F.col("shift_date") < F.lit(END_DATE).cast("date")))

never_collected = (window_jobs.filter(F.col("dispatch_gkey").isNotNull() & F.col("pickup_gkey").isNull())
                   .withColumn("reason", F.when(F.col("has_abjb") == 1, "abandoned").otherwise("not collected / cancelled")))
missing_arrivals = (window_jobs.filter(F.col("pickup_gkey").isNotNull()).select(
    "che_name", "wa", "dispatch_type",
    F.when((F.col("dispatch_type") == "TYCO") & (F.col("has_ayco") == 0), 1).otherwise(0).alias("missing_AYCO"),
    F.when((F.col("dispatch_type") == "TVCO") & (F.col("has_avco") == 0), 1).otherwise(0).alias("missing_AVCO"),
    F.when((F.col("carried_move") == "DSCH") & (F.col("has_aydr") == 0), 1).otherwise(0).alias("missing_AYDR")))

print("Picked-up jobs:", res.count(),
      "| no dispatch:", res.filter("no_dispatch = 1").count(),
      "| unmatched units:", res.filter("dq_unmatched_units = 1").count(),
      "| >2 units:", res.filter("dq_more_than_2_units = 1").count(),
      "| EC/MH crane mismatch:", res.filter("qc_ec_mh_mismatch = 1").count(),
      "| never collected:", never_collected.count())
display(summary.orderBy("shift_date", "shift_no", "che_name"))
display(missing_arrivals.groupBy().sum("missing_AYCO", "missing_AVCO", "missing_AYDR"))

# ===== Cell 9: fact_jobs (all picked-up jobs) for Power BI =====
arr = (ec.filter(F.col("wa").isNotNull() & F.col("event_type_desc").isin("AYCO", "AVCO", "AVDR", "AYDR"))
         .groupBy("che_name", "wa")
         .pivot("event_type_desc", ["AYCO", "AVCO", "AVDR", "AYDR"])
         .agg(F.min("event_ts")))
arr = arr.select("che_name", "wa", *[F.col(c).alias(f"{c.lower()}_ts") for c in ["AYCO", "AVCO", "AVDR", "AYDR"]])

def minutes(a, b):
    d = (F.col(b).cast("long") - F.col(a).cast("long")) / 60.0
    return F.when(d >= 0, F.round(d, 1))            # negative = mis-pressed button -> null

fact_jobs = (res.join(arr, ["che_name", "wa"], "left")
    .withColumn("pickup_arrival_ts", F.when(F.col("carried_move") == "LOAD", F.col("ayco_ts"))
                                      .when(F.col("carried_move") == "DSCH", F.col("avco_ts")))
    .withColumn("drop_arrival_ts",   F.when(F.col("carried_move") == "LOAD", F.col("avdr_ts"))
                                      .when(F.col("carried_move") == "DSCH", F.col("aydr_ts")))
    .withColumn("min_to_pickup_point", minutes("dispatch_ts", "pickup_arrival_ts"))
    .withColumn("min_wait_at_pickup",  minutes("pickup_arrival_ts", "pickup_ts"))
    .withColumn("min_pickup_to_cmpl",  minutes("pickup_ts", "cmpl_ts"))
    .withColumn("min_cycle",           minutes("dispatch_ts", "cmpl_ts"))
    .withColumn("is_base_job", ((F.col("no_dispatch") == 0) & (F.col("dq_more_than_2_units") == 0)).cast("int"))

# ===== Cell 10: fact_truck_shift (working hours per truck per shift) =====
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta

MAX_GAP_MIN = 60     # longer gaps without any ITV event, while "Working", count as "No activity"
STATUS = {"LGON": "Working", "AVAL": "Working", "UNAV": "Unavailable", "LGOF": "Logged off"}
STATES = ["Working", "Unavailable", "Logged off", "No activity"]

status_map = F.create_map(*[x for k, v in STATUS.items() for x in (F.lit(k), F.lit(v))])
data_end_ts = ec.agg(F.max("event_ts")).first()[0]          # open intervals end at the last EC event

w_ord = W.partitionBy("che_name").orderBy("ec_event_gkey")
w_all = w_ord.rowsBetween(W.unboundedPreceding, W.unboundedFollowing)
w_cum = w_ord.rowsBetween(W.unboundedPreceding, 0)

iv = (ec.select("che_name", "ec_event_gkey", "event_ts", "event_type_desc")
        .withColumn("status_evt", status_map[F.col("event_type_desc")])
        .withColumn("first_status_type",
                    F.first(F.when(F.col("status_evt").isNotNull(), F.col("event_type_desc")), ignorenulls=True).over(w_all))
        # state before the truck's first status event is inferred from that event
        .withColumn("initial_state", F.when(F.col("first_status_type") == "LGON", "Logged off")
                                      .when(F.col("first_status_type") == "AVAL", "Unavailable")
                                      .otherwise("Working"))
        .withColumn("state", F.coalesce(F.last("status_evt", ignorenulls=True).over(w_cum), F.col("initial_state")))
        .withColumn("start_ts", F.col("event_ts"))
        .withColumn("end_ts", F.coalesce(F.lead("event_ts").over(w_ord), F.lit(data_end_ts)))
        .withColumn("dur_min", F.greatest(F.lit(0.0), (F.col("end_ts").cast("long") - F.col("start_ts").cast("long")) / 60.0))
        .withColumn("state", F.when((F.col("state") == "Working") & (F.col("dur_min") > MAX_GAP_MIN), "No activity")
                              .otherwise(F.col("state")))
        .filter(F.col("end_ts") > F.col("start_ts")))

def build_shift_calendar(start_date, end_date):
    starts = sorted(datetime.strptime(s, "%H:%M").time() for s in SHIFT_STARTS)   # SHIFT_NAMES must follow this order
    d, last = date.fromisoformat(start_date) - timedelta(days=LOOKBACK_DAYS + 1), date.fromisoformat(end_date) + timedelta(days=1)
    rows = []
    while d <= last:
        for i, t in enumerate(starts):
            s = datetime.combine(d, t)
            e = datetime.combine(d, starts[i + 1]) if i + 1 < len(starts) else datetime.combine(d + timedelta(days=1), starts[0])
            rows.append((d, i + 1, SHIFT_NAMES[i], s, e))
        d += timedelta(days=1)
    return spark.createDataFrame(rows, "shift_date date, shift_no int, shift_name string, shift_start timestamp, shift_end timestamp")

cal = build_shift_calendar(START_DATE, END_DATE)

split = (iv.join(F.broadcast(cal), (F.col("start_ts") < F.col("shift_end")) & (F.col("end_ts") > F.col("shift_start")))
           .withColumn("hours", (F.least("end_ts", "shift_end").cast("long") -
                                 F.greatest("start_ts", "shift_start").cast("long")) / 3600.0)
           .filter((F.col("shift_date") >= F.lit(START_DATE).cast("date")) &
                   (F.col("shift_date") <  F.lit(END_DATE).cast("date"))))

fact_truck_shift = (split.groupBy(F.col("che_name").alias("truck"), "shift_date", "shift_no", "shift_name")
                         .pivot("state", STATES).agg(F.round(F.sum("hours"), 3))
                         .fillna(0, subset=STATES)
                         .withColumnRenamed("Working", "working_hours")
                         .withColumnRenamed("Unavailable", "unavailable_hours")
                         .withColumnRenamed("Logged off", "logged_off_hours")
                         .withColumnRenamed("No activity", "no_activity_hours")
                         .withColumn("shift_key", F.concat_ws("_", F.col("shift_date").cast("string"),
                                                                    F.col("shift_no").cast("string"))))

display(fact_truck_shift.groupBy("shift_date", "shift_name")
        .agg(F.countDistinct("truck").alias("trucks"),
             F.round(F.sum("working_hours"), 1).alias("working_h"),
             F.round(F.sum("unavailable_hours"), 1).alias("unavailable_h"),
             F.round(F.sum("no_activity_hours"), 1).alias("no_activity_h"))
        .orderBy("shift_date", "shift_name"))
